lawLevelReference.description: A world's Law Level controls possession and enforcement. The numbered ladder is cumulative: an item remains restricted at every higher Law Level after its first listed threshold.

armour.description: No general armour restriction is listed in the Core table.

augment.description: The Core table gives no blanket numeric ladder for augments. Governments may separately control technology, and the trade rules identify illegal cybernetics and combat enhancements; use an exact item rule or the world's law.

equipment.description: The Core table gives no blanket numeric ladder for general equipment. Drugs, information, computer programs, and technology may be controlled separately, so use an exact item rule or the world's law.

weapon.description: No general weapon restriction is listed in the Core table.

levels.summary: The Core Law Level table lists no general weapon or armour restrictions, although local, interstellar, and exact-item rules can still apply.
